amendments.body: This patch does not implement the requested root-zone oxygenation bead. The only functional changes are nitrification/alkalinity bookkeeping in `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229-241`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:12-23`, and `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:10-27`, with matching alkalinity coverage in `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs:1-336`. `git diff` shows no changes to the required substrate/plant touchpoints (`crates/tank_core/src/systems/substrate.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs`, `crates/tank_data/data/plant_guilds`), so the acceptance criteria around rooted-only biomass, saturated penetration-depth bonuses, planted-vs-unplanted divergence, and root-zone tracing remain entirely unimplemented.
amendments.rationale: The branch is solving a different problem than the bead it is supposed to close, so merging it would still leave the requested feature missing.

amendments.body: The change regresses deterministic save/load. After switching the default nitrification alkalinity constant in `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:337-338` and consuming it in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:169` and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:371-373`, `cargo test -p tank_core` now fails in `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs:340-372`. A save/load round-trip immediately changes the state because load re-solves carbonate state in `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:834-843`; in the active-cycle fixture the serialized state and the reloaded state already disagree on `water.ph`/`bicarbonate_mg_total`, so the resumed simulation diverges from the uninterrupted run. This needs a real fix before merge, either by keeping carbonate caches fresh before serialization or by ensuring post-chemistry alkalinity/DIC mutations cannot leave stale cached carbonate state behind.
amendments.rationale: Deterministic resume is an existing correctness contract, and this branch currently breaks it in the full test suite.

payload.summary: Reviewed the workspace diff in the worktree, read the changed implementation files, and ran `cargo test -p tank_core`. I found two blocking issues: the patch is unrelated to the requested root-zone oxygenation feature, and it introduces a save/load determinism regression that fails the existing test suite.
